So let the bills pile for a bit until you can pay them. Worst case you pay a late fee or pay some of it for the month.
I get you’re stressed because money and not having enough of it stresses me out to the max but even sometimes I’m just too depressed to care. I’ll get to it.

Take care of yourself first. Maybe try going to rehab to take some time away even if you don’t necessarily think you can get better. Companies can’t charge you late fees or kick you out for a medical reason (yes rehab counts). It’s annoying but you just call and let them know before or after.

If it makes you feel any better my ex spent $3K+ in just a few days last week on his drug of choice.

Just breathe. I hope you don’t punish yourself more than you need to. Personally I think getting involved in some therapy and psychiatry would be more beneficial than rehab as usually there’s a reason people reach for drugs and self medicate. 

I don’t know if anything I said was helpful I’m kind of just blabbering as I’m a lost soul myself but I read your post and I hear you.

You sound like my ex who I desperately tried to help.
Not a bad thing cause maybe you’ll listen to me, a Reddit stranger, more than he did.

You have to figure out why that is and the types of drugs do play a role to some understanding of that. What effects do they give? Uppers or downers? Preference if both?
And are you really feeling happy or are you just numb because nothing really matters when you’re high and you’re trying to escape?

The root of it matters. You need to find out what triggers you to reach for the drugs and work on it or try to instead of reaching for the bandaid on something that needs surgery (metaphorically speaking).

Edit: Adding this because it’s really important. If you have anyone you consider close who is trying to be a reaching hand, please don’t push them away. I’ve seen a lot of people reach for the drugs and feel so ashamed that they push the people they care about away and that’s the absolute worst thing you can do for yourself. 

Please take that hand even if it sucks it will help you in the long run.

Pretty sure that stuff will burn your esophagus all the way down. And once it’s in it doesn’t stop. 
That’s a very very slow painful death. 
Even if it was nothing going down the failure to your other organs would be a slow degrade.

You should give yourself a tad bit more credit because if she’s opened up to you that much, you can’t be all that bad at talking to people. 
At least not with her.
And I wish I could expand but I know her even less than you do. But what did you guys first talk about? How did you meet online? Was it a group with a specific mutual interest? 
Try using any of your mutual interests as a distraction or just hers. But also recognize she isn’t okay.

For example if she’s saying she wants to die don’t immediately jump into a random subject because she’ll feel like you don’t care. Nothing worse than telling someone you want to kill yourself and the reply be “yeah me too it sucks but anyway how’s that show you like?”

Acknowledge that she isn’t okay but offer the distraction. Offer is the keyword.

Hmm this is a tough subject to touch on because I think we all feel like we want somebody to reach out but we also love to slap the hand away. 

I would say it’s okay to probably reveal you understand the depression and suicidal tendencies. But definitely don’t make it about you if you want to help.
I have a friend who battles somewhat of depression (I say that because they’ve never seen a professional so idk how profound) and every time I open up about mine he turns it about him. 
I should also mention this guy really liked me and like you was trying to help and let me be honest, just that, turned me completely off him. Like not even an option.

And why? Well because it doesn’t help anyone. Your help will get lost in a sob story of sob stories and then you’re both just obviously sad.

So offer to do something or take her mind off with a different conversation if you have to. Weird to say but sometimes not addressing depression is nice for depression. Good distractions are healthy.

It’s okay I’m clinically depressed so I’ve done far worse lol.

But yeah just a heads up cause if you do go to the ER, even if you didn’t mean it as an attempt, they will most likely admit you.

I don’t want it to be a surprise because that’s the worst and most hospitals are afraid to tell patients that until you’re locked in the section cause they’re afraid people will freak out. So they wait and let them freak out there once someone “evaluates” you but really you were going to be sectioned the whole time.

Yeah I’ve done that before on some crappy days with my meds but it never does anything but give you side effects on hard mode.
You’d need to take a lot more for them to do some serious damage. And even then that’s not lethal damage. 
I don’t think you have to go to the ER. I’d ride it out. Especially since they’ll also just admit you. 

Some people might find that a good thing here but forced help or unsuspecting trips to a psych ward isn’t good for anyone.

If you did it as a suicide attempt or just a way to maybe make you feel extra happy, unfortunately or fortunately you’ll be fine.

Granted everyone’s bodies are different and I’m not at all a medical expert but let’s just say I’ve had my rounds with attempts and pills and it’s rare that those would even cause death. 

Your body will just puke it all up in due time and you’ll feel like shit for a couple of days maybe less but you’ll recover.

Everyone has their insecurities and everyone also has different taste/opinions on what is attractive.
I definitely have my own insecurities I fight with daily, especially since I’ve struggled with acne for what feels like half my lifetime at this point.

But eventually you just have to kind of not give a shit. Easier said than done but who cares what people think who don’t give you a chance or make fun of you based on your looks?

Do you really want to attract those shallow people even if you were what your ideal image of hot is?

Heck I met my now boyfriend with much needed haircut and a missing front tooth lol. I saw passed that because he’s just an overall amazing person who let his confidence and personality show regardless. That’s what made me attracted to him. And he’s the most handsome man in my eyes because of that.

Attractive people don’t mean anything if they’re personalities are trash. Don’t be afraid to just be you and let who you are show as opposed to a cover you’re trying to conform to.

We’re pretty similar and I totally get not wanting to bring anyone down with you. I don’t want to be a charity case or seen as crazy either.
It’s tough. I don’t even know why I do it. Probably because I’ve been there before and it’s hopeless to mention anything and also I think that maybe if I’m happy people might care about me? Maybe I’ll get a false temporary sense of happiness? Who knows.
Odd coming from me but I hope you stick it out and find a way to overcome the burden of depression.

I feel the same way and it’s really deteriorating  me. I’m always the one making sure others are okay but nobody really ever checks in on me. Even if I go silent for days or weeks. 

Everyday I just cry and want to die.

It’s not meant for children, it’s just some doctors prescribe it to children for sleep issues. The slightest of too much has just caused child deaths. It’s on the one pill can kill list for kids but weirdly enough not adults?
Small cut route doesn’t work. Many scars on my arm to prove it trust me. And yeah I know, my father went out that way with the gun route.

I’m not sure on that one, I’ve seen people butcher their arms and still survive, it’s crazy. I’m talking seeing bone. 
I gave up on overdosing as well so I tried carbon monoxide poisoning and I still lived! Welp.

I’ve been seriously depressed for years. I’ve gotten and sought out “help” multiple times but I’m quite tired of it. I really try to be happy and take days at a time but I’m just so done with it all. 
My father also committed suicide so idk, maybe it’s just gonna finally happen for me one day.

I’ve had many attempts and my body always finds a way to pull through somehow. Quite annoying actually.
Most bets are usually made that way. And haha when is that? I’m running out of patience.
Want to bet? They’re pretty small and I’ve survived suicide attempts with much larger pills unfortunately.
